title: Separate source-page labels from current legal status

status_fields.meaning: The exact status text observed on a carrier page, scoped to that page and observation time.
status_fields.display_condition: Must be labeled as source-page status and include source owner and last-observed timestamp.

status_fields.meaning: A status implication from document labels such as motion to terminate, order dismissing case, partial termination, sustainment plan, or closing letter.
status_fields.display_condition: Must be displayed as signal/flag, not resolved status.

status_fields.meaning: Status derived from a current court order after URL capture, docket reconciliation, and date-effective review.
status_fields.display_condition: Requires docket/court-order source, reviewer signoff, and rollback path.

status_fields.meaning: Internal tentative synthesis awaiting current verification.

public_label_format: {status_label} — source-page label observed from {source_owner} on {observed_at}; not independently reverified as current court status.
rollback_rule: If any status field changes, create a status_event and preserve the prior label as historical source observation; do not silently overwrite.
